sentence.en: I choose a gentle breed of dog.
sentence.ar: أنا أختار سلالة لطيفة من الكلاب.

examples.en: I choose a gentle breed of dog.

examples.en: I am not choosing a gentle breed of dog.

examples.en: I did not choose a gentle breed of dog.

examples.en: I have chosen a gentle breed of dog.

examples.en: I have not chosen a gentle breed of dog.

examples.en: I will choose a gentle breed of dog.
